method: Hand input. For every site rater 1 labelled real-barrier (classifications.json, hit and hidden samples), whether a rule that fires there names the barrier the rater describes (yes), names it for the wrong reason, e.g. a rule that fires on every input (byAccident), points near it (partly), or objects to something else (no); and which linter's rule does. Read from the rater's note and the rules at the site.

a004.note: The rules want a role on the hover wrapper; the barrier is that the inner click target isn't focusable or keyboard-operable.

a008.note: control-has-associated-label on the unlabelled file-name input; Oxlint's version skips inputs by default.

a009.note: prefer-tag-over-role / useSemanticElements object to role=checkbox, which works; the barrier is the missing name.

a011.note: ESLint's control-has-associated-label fires on every input under this config; here the label's htmlFor points at an id that doesn't exist.

a022.note: noSvgWithoutTitle on the only content of an unnamed menu button; Oxlint and ESLint don't see it through the spread.

a024.note: A label tied to no control.

a033.note: prefer-tag-over-role on role=list suggests <ul>; the barrier is that the items have no listitem role.

a064.note: useValidAnchor on <a onClick> without href (latent: no caller passes breadcrumbs today).

a066.note: prefer-tag-over-role objects to role=combobox; the barrier is the icon-only trigger's missing name.

a067.note: label-has-associated-control on a Label with no htmlFor; only ESLint, because of its labelComponents option.

h005.note: Hidden set: control-has-associated-label would name the unnamed clear button once told what the component renders.

h013.note: Hidden set: anchor-ambiguous-text on 'Learn more'; meets WCAG 2.4.4 in context.

h018.note: Hidden set: the mapped rules complain about a missing role and key handler that the component supplies; the real problem is an extra do-nothing tab stop.

h024.note: Hidden set: control-has-associated-label on an icon-only menu button with no name.
